title: Hosted CI red: internal/loadfence TestThreadWaitSnapshotMeasuresRealDescheduling measures no runqueue wait on the GitHub runner

red.message: threadwait_test.go:140: no runqueue wait measured across three 80.449546ms windows with 3 competitors on 1 P: the sample is inert

green.role: fix commit merged (worker de7f72e on wt/INT-CI-9)

change.mechanism: Goroutines multiplex onto GOMAXPROCS OS threads, so 3 spinning competitors on 1 P are ONE runnable thread: the Go scheduler preempts in-process while the kernel never enqueues, so schedstat field 2 stays flat and the sample reads inert on a quiet runner. The control now escalates the RUNNABLE THREAD COUNT and the window: 1P/3 competitors -> NumCPU P/NumCPU -> NumCPU+2 P/NumCPU+8 competitors, 40ms -> 100ms -> 250ms windows, failing loudly if the sample is still inert after the full ladder.

open_question: The top rung is derived from runtime.NumCPU(), so a 2-core runner tops out at 4 P / 10 competitors — the same regime that was inert at 051a199 could still read 0 there. A floor on the top rung (e.g. >= 16 competitors absolute) would close that; it is not yet implemented.
verification_note: CI conclusions above were read from `gh run list --repo trouble-agent/trouble --json databaseId,conclusion,headSha,createdAt` on 2026-11-17, not inferred.
